_comment: Carried over from 05293190AC by tools/port.py; do not edit by hand, edit the reference annotations and re-run.

units.spark: degrees BTDC = x / 2 (signed tables: two's complement)
units.pos256: position 0-255 along the rows (or columns) of a 3D table

0A12.name: WotMapScale
0A12.desc: MAP to row position of the WOT spark and fuel tables

0B74.name: InjectorDeadTime
0B74.desc: Injector dead time against battery voltage

1281.name: PartThrottleFuel
1281.desc: Part-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

132E.name: WotFuel
132E.desc: Wide-open-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

1652.name: BaroFuel
1652.desc: Pulse width added to the fuel pulse against barometric pressure (result x 8)

2D35.name: KnockThreshold
2D35.desc: Knock sensor voltage threshold against rpm

2E8D.name: SparkCoolantCorrA
2E8D.desc: Spark correction against coolant temperature (one of two variants, chosen by the caller)

2E97.name: SparkCoolantCorrB
2E97.desc: Spark correction against coolant temperature (second variant)

2F95.name: IdleTargetRpm
2F95.desc: Target idle speed against coolant temperature

57AE.name: ThrottleLimpFromVacuum
57AE.desc: Substitute throttle position from manifold vacuum when the TPS has failed

704B.name: ThermistorCold
704B.desc: Thermistor ADC counts to temperature, cold range (-55 to 83 C), used after the pull-up is switched

705B.name: ThermistorHot
705B.desc: Thermistor ADC counts to temperature, hot range (13 to 127 C); coolant and intake air

0B90.name: PartThrottleFuelK
0B90.desc: K factor of the part-throttle base pulse width: (MAP - offset) * (256 + K) / 16

0B91.name: PartThrottleFuelMapOffset
0B91.desc: MAP offset of the part-throttle base pulse width

0B92.name: WotFuelK
0B92.desc: K factor of the WOT base pulse width

0B93.name: WotFuelMapOffset
0B93.desc: MAP offset of the WOT base pulse width

1E7B.name: RevLimit
1E7B.desc: Rev limit, used while $0C31,Z bit 5 is set (2GNT: manual transmission / park-neutral)

1E7D.name: RevLimitAlt
1E7D.desc: Rev limit, used while $0C31,Z bit 5 is clear

45F9.name: FaultTable
45F9.desc: Fault attributes: id, trigger count, blink code, attributes, bit mask, byte offset, P-code (BCD), 2 spare bytes
